data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1414 recorded an adverse prior-year development on claims in 2016: gross claims outstanding increased by GBP 70.589m (a c.15.4% strengthening versus opening gross reserves of GBP 459.025m), with a reinsurers' share partially offsetting this movement (reinsurers' share GBP 22.997m, net movement GBP 47.592m). Notwithstanding this gross strengthening, the technical account narrative refers to a run-off surplus for prior accident years of GBP 21.5m (net metric), reflecting offsets and other technical items. The report also highlights a number of large loss events in 2015 and 2016 (e.g. Tianjin, Abkatun, Hurricane Matthew, Jubilee FPSO, Space X) which have influenced claim development and volatility.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from claims components (not including unearned premium) at 1 Jan 2016 (Notified claims + IBNR = GBP 459.025m). Prior-year development uses the gross 'Arising from prior-year claims' line in the Movements in insurance liabilities note (GBP 70.589k = GBP 70.589m) (confidence high). There is a seeming inconsistency between the gross movement (adverse GBP 70.589m) and the technical account narrative which reports a net run-off surplus of GBP 21.5m (this net figure reflects reinsurance and other P&L offsets). Lob-level gross prior-year reserve movements are not provided; some narrative numbers are net of reinsurance only. The claims development triangle is provided in thousands.
